title: Tech Note: Sliding Tab in 4D
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D form object events (On Load, On Bound Variable Change, On Timer)

historical_commentary.text: This is a textbook example of classic-4D-era custom UI engineering that modern 4D development would rarely reproduce this way: today's equivalent would typically be built with CSS/JS transitions in a web area or a fully web-based (Qodly/ORDA-REST) front end, which handle sliding/carousel effects natively and far more efficiently than manual pixel-shifting timers on classic form objects. The component would still run technically, but the approach is superseded by web UI techniques.
related_updates: 4D Web Area with CSS/JS carousel libraries
Qodly Studio web components for modern responsive UI
